questions.q: Which panel in Lightning App Builder lists every component you can drag onto a page?
questions.explain: The Components panel, on the left, is the palette of every standard and custom component available to drag.

questions.q: What is the basic workflow for adding a component to a Lightning page?
options: Write Apex, then compile, then deploy
Drag it from the Components panel, drop it on the canvas, then configure it in the right-hand panel
Edit the org's metadata XML directly
questions.explain: Drag, drop, configure — no code is required at any step of building a Lightning page.

questions.q: Which Lightning App Builder page type overrides the standard layout for a single object?
questions.explain: A Record Page overrides an object's standard record layout — it's steadily replacing classic page layouts.

questions.q: Which page type would you use to build a custom home page just for one specific custom app?
questions.explain: An App Page builds a custom home page scoped to one app, as opposed to the org-wide Home Page.

questions.q: What has to happen after saving a Lightning page before users can actually see it?
options: Activation — publishing the saved page so it's visible to users
Rewriting it as a Visualforce page
questions.explain: Saving stores the page, but activation is the separate step that makes it visible to users.
